messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Gabapentin is a prescription medicine used to treat partial seizures, nerve pain from shingles (postherpetic neuralgia), and restless legs syndrome (Horizant brand only). It may also be prescribed off-label for other conditions including diabetic nerve pain, anxiety, and fibromyalgia. Gabapentin is thought to work by calming overactive nerve signals in the brain and nervous system. It is an anticonvulsant and nerve pain medication from the drug class gabapentinoids
Gabapentin brand names are Neurontin, Gralise, Horizant, and Relgaabi, which may not be interchangeable.
Gabapentin is not a federally controlled substance, but some states classify it as Schedule V and others require gabapentin prescriptions to be reported to their prescription drug monitoring program (PDMP). Rules on refills and quantity limits vary by state.
The most common side effects of gabapentin are dizziness, drowsiness (somnolence), and swelling in the hands or feet (peripheral edema). These often improve as your body adjusts, but do not drive until you know how gabapentin affects you.
Triplet: ["Gabapentin", "has off label use", "anxiety"]

The relation 'has off label use' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is prescribed for the condition specified by the object entity outside of its approved indications.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'not used to treat': The subject drug is inappropriate or contraindicated for the treatment of the condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
E. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
